meta.projectName: Scottie Gold Mine Project (2025 PEA Base Case - source-grounded runtime proxy)
meta.notes: EJ VERIFIERAD REPORT-RECONCILIATION. Source: Tetra Tech Canada Inc., Preliminary Economic Assessment, NI 43-101 Technical Report for the Scottie Gold Mine Project, effective 28 October 2025. The public PEA discloses one pre-production year, seven production years and a terminal Year 8 cash-flow period, but not the annual sustaining-capital, working-capital, tax-pool/BC Mineral Tax or NPI cash-flow series used by the underlying financial model. This V3 therefore separates report facts from explicit runtime proxies and must not be described as report-verified. Report facts locked here: Au US$2,600/oz; CAD1.00=USD0.72; 5% mid-year discounting; 2.19 Mt plant feed; 1.24 Mt sorted concentrate; 94.7% LOM recovery; 457,600 oz recovered/payable-in-summary gold; smelter payability 88.3% LOM average; initial CAPEX C$128.6m; sustaining CAPEX C$76.7m including C$15m closure/reclamation distributed over LOM; salvage C$12.9m; 2.0% Franco-Nevada gross production royalty; statutory 15% federal + 12% BC corporate income tax plus separate BC Mineral Tax; reported AISC US$1,452/oz. Table 25-1 Y1-Y7 mine schedule is used for economic production. Table 16-20 separately shows a 4 kt Y8 tail and 2.191 Mt total; that internal report discrepancy is retained as evidence and is not blended into the economic schedule. Runtime proxies: annual recovered-gold shape is normalized to the report total 457,600 oz from Table 25-1 contained-gold shape; annual sorted-concentrate tonnes are allocated pro-rata to Table 25-1 plant feed while preserving 1.24 Mt LOM; annual non-closure sustaining CAPEX is allocated pro-rata to plant feed; closure C$15m is spread equally across Y1-Y7 because the PEA says it is distributed over LOM but gives no annual schedule; working capital targets one month of annual at-mine revenue and is fully released in terminal Y8; depreciation uses the legacy 27.5% declining-balance proxy solely to provide a runtime tax shield; runtime tax is the disclosed 27% general corporate rate with loss carryforward and does not reconstruct BC Mineral Tax, tax pools, new-mine allowance or NPI. The NPI is mentioned as included in the PEA economics but no rate, formula or annual series is disclosed, so no NPI amount is guessed.

report.assumptionsNotes: EJ VERIFIERAD. Public disclosure omits annual sustaining/closure allocation, annual working-capital balances, annual tax cash flows/tax pools and the NPI rate/formula/series. Report summaries include C$76.7m sustaining capital including C$15.0m closure; verification.reportSustainingCapexUSD therefore stores the arithmetically derived non-closure portion C$61.7m so the separated V3 sustaining and closure ledgers can be hard-checked without double counting. No working-capital hard target is stored because the report discloses only that WC varies annually and is recovered at mine-life end.
